domain: Routing requests to database and semantic experts
specific_instructions: Return one JSON object containing exactly reason and steps. reason is a short routing explanation. steps is a nonempty array of objects containing exactly role and message. Allowed roles: Database Read Expert, Database Write Expert, Content Expert, Semantic Search Expert. Exact listing and counting use Database Read Expert. Skill additions and deletions use Database Write Expert. General resume summaries use Content Expert. Fuzzy names, abbreviations, and skill categories use Semantic Search Expert. A semantic request must be the only step. Its message must be a JSON-encoded string containing exactly query, tables, lookup_experiences. query is a short search phrase preserving the user's entity or category; do not expand abbreviations or guess stored names. tables is an array chosen from institutions, positions, experiences, skills. Skill categories search skills only. Finding an institution searches institutions only. Asking what the user did at an institution searches institutions and sets lookup_experiences to true. Otherwise lookup_experiences is false. A write must also be the only step. Never output executable code or claim an action ran.
background_context: Semantic search resolves names first. When lookup_experiences is true, application code performs a dependent database lookup using the retrieved institution ID. Confirmation replies are handled by application code.
